neighbours.label: the verb or next word when people go somewhere or meet someone in a recount of events (went swimming, headed to, spoke with, visit the), as opposed to the same time frames with weather or prices
fire: On Friday we finished our posters and went sledding after lunch.
After the assembly the class headed to the library.
The prime minister spoke with the French president on Sunday.
Next we walked to the fire station and met the crew.
Tomorrow evening visit the science museum and try the maze.
At noon I went with my sister to a concert.
On Monday the mayor met with local farmers in the hall.
Then the children went outside to the playground.
quiet: On Friday the wind dropped and snow lasted until after lunch.
After the storm the river rose above the bank.
The price of wheat fell by a cent on Sunday.
Next year rents are due to climb in the city.
Tomorrow evening clouds are likely and the air will cool.
At noon the sun came out over the hills.
On Monday the euro gained against the dollar in trading.
Then the fog lifted slowly from the bay.

short: going somewhere or meeting someone, in a recount
notes: The near misses have no people, so they are easy. The card's peaks are mostly function words, and a probe of 'we went to visit a farm' scored just 0.14.
